# Mirage 1.0.9

本版本重点增强 Steam 会话与创意工坊下载的故障恢复能力，并修复多标签筛选、场景效果采样、视频纹理刷新和 MetalFX 呈现稳定性。

## 重大更新：Steam 会话与下载恢复

- Steam 连接短暂中断时会使用稳定的登录标识和已保存的刷新令牌自动重连，并通过有界退避持续恢复；只有 Steam 明确拒绝保存的会话时才要求重新登录，减少网络波动导致的意外掉线。
- Steam 服务组件意外退出后会自动重启、恢复登录并重新提交仍在进行的下载任务。下载暂存目录与已校验分块会被复用，不再因服务或连接中断丢弃已经下载的内容。
- 改进 Steam 内容服务器选择与容错：缓存可用服务器、降低失败节点优先级，并为清单和内容分块增加跨服务器重试。单个下载现在可使用全局八个分块连接，多个任务同时运行时共享该上限。

## 创意工坊修复

- 修复同时选择多个标签时可能错误返回空结果的问题；查询现在按“匹配任一所选标签”合并并去重结果，同时保留其他筛选条件 (PR #35)。

## 场景渲染修复

- 修复透传效果未始终保留独立采样相机，以及合成图层绑定到错误渲染目标的问题，改善非全屏效果、后处理和合成场景的显示。
- 修复资源刷新重新划分视频纹理活动周期，导致部分场景中的视频材质停止更新的问题；相同的填充模式也不再触发重复资源刷新。
- 加强 MetalFX 呈现器的能力检查、纹理输入和线性回退路径，并将 MetalFX 默认改为关闭；用户仍可在性能设置中手动启用。

## 下载

- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac
- `x86_64`：Intel Mac
- 系统要求：macOS 14.2 或更高版本

当前构建使用临时签名，首次打开时可能需要在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」中选择“仍要打开”。

# Mirage 1.0.9

This release strengthens recovery for Steam sessions and Workshop downloads while fixing multi-tag filtering, Scene effect sampling, video-texture refreshes, and MetalFX presentation stability.

## Major Update: Steam Session and Download Recovery

- Temporary Steam connection losses now recover automatically using a stable login ID and the saved refresh token, with bounded backoff between attempts. Mirage asks for another login only when Steam explicitly rejects the saved session, reducing unexpected sign-outs caused by network interruptions.
- If the Steam service exits unexpectedly, Mirage restarts it, restores the session, and resubmits active download tasks. Staged files and already validated chunks are reused instead of discarding downloaded content after a service or connection interruption.
- Improved Steam content-server selection and failover by caching available servers, deprioritizing failing hosts, and retrying manifests and content chunks across servers. A single download can now use all eight global chunk connections, while concurrent items share that limit.

## Workshop Fixes

- Fixed multi-tag filtering sometimes returning no results. Queries now merge and deduplicate items matching any selected tag while retaining the other active filters (PR #35).

## Scene Rendering Fixes

- Fixed passthrough effects not always retaining a dedicated sampling camera and composite layers binding to the wrong render target, improving non-fullscreen effects, post-processing, and composite scenes.
- Fixed resource refreshes advancing the video-texture activity cycle and consequently stopping some video materials from updating. Reapplying an unchanged fill mode also no longer triggers another resource refresh.
- Hardened MetalFX presenter capability checks, texture inputs, and linear fallback behavior. MetalFX is now disabled by default and remains available as an opt-in setting under Performance.

## Downloads

- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac
- `x86_64` for Intel Mac
- Requires macOS 14.2 or later

Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.
